title: SMProfile-ThermoplasticClass payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/material/thermoplastic-class.json 1.0.0; do not edit by hand. Envelope: standard/payloads/envelope.schema.json.

material_class_id.description: Identity of the material class (e.g. PA66-GF30).

parent_class_ref.description: The broader class whose properties this class includes (INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF).

polymer_family.description: Polymer as designated by ISO 1043-1 (e.g. PA66, PMMA, ASA+PC).

filler_type.description: Filler or reinforcement as designated by ISO 1043-2 (e.g. GF glass fibre, CF carbon fibre, MD mineral); absent when unfilled.

filler_content.description: Filler content in mass percent (the 30 in PA66-GF30).

residual_moisture_max.description: Maximum residual moisture at processing (supplier datasheet).

melt_temp_min.description: Lower end of the melt temperature window (supplier datasheet).

melt_temp_max.description: Upper end of the melt temperature window (supplier datasheet).

mould_temp_min.description: Lower end of the mould temperature window (supplier datasheet).

mould_temp_max.description: Upper end of the mould temperature window (supplier datasheet).
